about.en: Nietzschean Penguin (PENGUIN) is a Solana memecoin launched on pump.fun, inspired by the lone penguin walking toward the mountains in Werner Herzog's documentary Encounters at the End of the World. It is the SPL mint 8Jx8AAHj86wbQgUTjGuj6GTTL5Ps3cqxKRTvpaJApump with a supply of about 1 billion; it is a culture token with no product behind it.
